description: Electrochemistry + batteries decomposed. Lithium-ion variants (LFP, NMC, NCA), solid-state batteries, sodium-ion, flow batteries, fuel cells (PEM, SOFC), electrolysis (H2 production, chlor-alkali), supercapacitors, corrosion mechanisms.

sub_mechanisms.name: Li_ion_intercalation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Li⁺ shuttles between cathode (LiCoO2/NMC/LFP) + anode (graphite). Charge/discharge reversible.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of all Li-ion. Anode + cathode host Li without structural change. Nobel 2019.

sub_mechanisms.name: LFP_LiFePO4
sub_mechanisms.definition: Olivine cathode. Lower energy density but safer + longer cycle life.
sub_mechanisms.why: Thermal stability (no thermal runaway at high T). EV battery preferred for safety. Tesla LFP cars.

sub_mechanisms.name: NMC_NCA_cathodes
sub_mechanisms.definition: LiNi_x Mn_y Co_z O2 (NMC) or LiNi_x Co_y Al_z O2 (NCA). Higher energy density than LFP.
sub_mechanisms.why: EV range. Higher voltage + capacity. Cost: cobalt + thermal stability concerns. Industry shifting Co content down.

sub_mechanisms.name: solid_state_battery
sub_mechanisms.definition: Solid electrolyte (ceramic/polymer/sulfide) replaces liquid. Lithium metal anode possible.
sub_mechanisms.why: Higher energy density, safety, faster charge. Manufacturing challenges. Toyota, QuantumScape major players.

sub_mechanisms.name: sodium_ion_battery
sub_mechanisms.definition: Na⁺ instead of Li⁺. Cheaper, abundant. Lower energy density.
sub_mechanisms.why: Stationary storage. CATL + BYD producing. Trade: 30-50% lower density vs Li-ion. Cost wins for grid.

sub_mechanisms.name: flow_battery_redox
sub_mechanisms.definition: Electrolyte stored in external tanks. Vanadium most common. Power × energy decoupled.
sub_mechanisms.why: Long-duration grid storage. Cheap energy capacity (more tank); power separate. Long cycle life.

sub_mechanisms.name: PEM_fuel_cell
sub_mechanisms.definition: Proton Exchange Membrane. Anode: H2 → 2H⁺ + 2e⁻. Cathode: O2 + 4H⁺ + 4e⁻ → 2H2O.
sub_mechanisms.why: Automotive (Toyota Mirai). Low T operation (~80°C). Pt catalyst expensive. Hydrogen infrastructure challenge.

sub_mechanisms.name: SOFC_solid_oxide
sub_mechanisms.why: High efficiency, fuel flexible. Cost: expensive materials + slow start. Bloom Energy commercial.

sub_mechanisms.name: water_electrolysis
sub_mechanisms.definition: 2H2O → 2H2 + O2. Alkaline, PEM, SOEC (high-T). Hydrogen production.
sub_mechanisms.why: Green H2 from renewables. Foundation of hydrogen economy. Efficiency 60-80%. Scaling up rapidly.

sub_mechanisms.name: chlor_alkali_process
sub_mechanisms.definition: Electrolyse NaCl brine. Produces Cl2, NaOH, H2. Largest industrial electrolysis.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of chemical industry. Modern: membrane cells. Energy-intensive but essential.

sub_mechanisms.name: supercapacitor
sub_mechanisms.definition: Electrochemical double-layer capacitor. Charge stored at electrode-electrolyte interface.
sub_mechanisms.why: Fast charge/discharge, long cycle life. Lower energy density than batteries. Hybrid systems: capacitor + battery.

sub_mechanisms.name: cathodic_protection
sub_mechanisms.definition: Make protected metal cathode. Sacrificial anode (Zn, Mg) or impressed current.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard corrosion protection. Ships, pipelines, water heaters. Anode corrodes sacrificially. Periodic replacement.

derivation_rules.name: LFP_vs_NMC_safety_vs_density_tradeoff
then: LFP safer + cheaper; NMC higher range
derivation_rules.why: LFP: thermal stability + abundant Fe; lower kWh/kg. NMC: higher kWh/kg; cobalt + Ni cost; thermal sensitivity. Application-driven choice.

derivation_rules.name: solid_state_enables_Li_metal_anode
derivation_rules.why: Li metal: 10x capacity vs graphite. Dendrites short cells in liquid. Solid: mechanical barrier. Holy grail of batteries.

derivation_rules.name: fuel_cell_efficiency_beats_combustion
then: efficiency higher than combustion + heat engine
derivation_rules.why: Direct electrochemical: no Carnot limit. 50-60% efficient. Cars: more efficient than gasoline + ICE. Hydrogen logistics challenge.

derivation_rules.name: flow_battery_decouples_power_energy
derivation_rules.why: Energy capacity = tank volume (cheap). Power = stack size (more expensive). Long-duration: scale tanks. Grid storage applications.

derivation_rules.name: cathodic_protection_prevents_metal_loss
then: protected metal stays intact while anode corrodes
derivation_rules.why: Anode more anodic than protected metal. All corrosion current goes to anode. Replaced periodically. Standard corrosion engineering.
